definitions.explanation: The folder or location where incoming email, messages, or notifications are stored. Standard terminology in email and messaging applications.

examples.japanese: {受信箱|じゅしんばこ}に{新|あたら}しいメールが{届|とど}いた。
examples.english: A new email arrived in my inbox.

examples.japanese: {受信箱|じゅしんばこ}がいっぱいなので、{古|ふる}いメールを{削除|さくじょ}した。
examples.english: My inbox was full, so I deleted old emails.

examples.japanese: {迷惑|めいわく}メールが{受信箱|じゅしんばこ}に{入|はい}らないように、フィルターを{設定|せってい}した。
examples.english: I set up a filter so that spam wouldn't get into my inbox.

notes:
USAGE:
The standard Japanese term for email inbox. The counterpart is {送信箱|そうしんばこ} (outbox / sent folder). On smartphones, the inbox may be called {受信|じゅしん}トレイ or simply {受信|じゅしん}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {受信箱|じゅしんばこ}を{確認|かくにん}する (to check one's inbox)
- {受信箱|じゅしんばこ}を{整理|せいり}する (to organize one's inbox)
- {受信箱|じゅしんばこ}が{空|から} (inbox is empty)
